description: A photograph depicting a managed urban green area, characteristic of a park or large public garden. The image prominently features a well-maintained green lawn under bright sunlight. Several mature deciduous trees are visible, with those in the mid-ground casting distinct long shadows, indicating late afternoon. In the background, partially obscured by foliage, a multi-story building with a reddish roof and light-coloured walls can be seen, placing the scene within an urban or suburban environment. This visual example corresponds to the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) classification for "green urban areas" defined as public recreational spaces like gardens or urban parks.
